恭喜魔王诞生，恭喜魔王诞生，第一口黑锅已发放（第22页）周围围了几十个神明，有的抱着胳膊，有的搓着手掌，有的急得在虚空中来回踱步，催促声此起彼伏。“怎么样？查没查到啊。”“这么大的动静，谁搞出来的？”“刚刚吓了我一跳，有机会必须得跟那人比试一番。”“你？算了吧，那一剑你能接住半招就算你命大。”……预言之神始终闭着眼，指尖在虚空中缓缓划过一道又一道预言法则纹路。片刻之后他睁开眼，面色肃穆。“我得到预言了。”众神哗啦一下围上来，连远处那几个还在争论剑痕强度的神明都停下了对话，竖起耳朵。预言之神开口了，声音不大，但每一个字都清晰地落进在场所有人的耳朵里。“破坏石口城的人，是今天刚刚降临的半神。”全场寂静了整整三息，然后炸开了锅。“刚刚降临？那不就是婴儿？刚出生就有这本事？这要成长起来得是什么怪物。”“恐怖如斯。哪位神明的后代竟然有这等本事？”众神七嘴八舌地议论着，没有人注意到预言之神微微垂下眼帘。他修长的手指在龟壳上轻轻敲了两下，敲得很轻很轻，像是把某个不该说出口的答案偷偷藏进了龟壳的纹路里。就在这时，人群中忽然有人开口。“我记得……暴怒之神一年前在凡间宠幸了一个女人。”众神的议论声戛然而止，所有人齐刷刷地转头看向说话的人。那人被这么多双眼睛盯着，下意识地缩了缩脖子，但还是硬着头皮把话说完。“那女人就住在石口城。”场面一下子安静了。神界都知道，暴怒之神一年前在凡间留了个种。当时还在酒宴上醉醺醺地吹嘘过，说他儿子将来必然继承他的怒火神格，让整个神界都为之颤抖。当时谁也没当回事，暴怒之神每次喝醉了都这么说，光是有记载的私生子就有十几个，没一个成器的。但这一次不一样。石口城的方向，剑锋的余波还在虚空中嗤嗤作响。那不是一个刚出生的婴儿能打出来的攻击。可如果那个婴儿继承了暴怒之神的怒火神格，又在诞生时意外触发了某种更古老的法则传承呢？“算算日子，确实差不多了。”“我之前听暴怒之神说过，要给那孩子取名叫雷杰来着。不会就是他吧。”“雷杰……刚出生就劈了一座城？这暴怒是生了个什么怪物出来？”“啧，这下麻烦了。暴怒之神本来就是个一点就炸的炮仗，现在又多了一个这么强的儿子。父子俩联手，以后神界还能有太平日子？”“太平日子？暴怒那脾气，你什么时候见他太平过？现在好了，儿子比他还能打，以后谁敢惹他？”“惹他？我现在连他儿子都不敢惹，必须得认真对待。”……而此时，石口城边缘的一间医院里，一名婴儿刚刚诞生。这正是替林默背了黑锅的雷杰，也是日后让人闻风丧胆的第一代魔王。

Chapter 480 Congratulations to the Devil on the birth of the first scapegoat (page 1)
Congratulations on the birth of the Demon King. Congratulations on the birth of the Demon King. The first black pot has been handed out (page 22). Dozens of gods were surrounded. Some were holding their arms, some were rubbing their palms, and some were pacing back and forth in the void in a hurry. The sounds of urging came and went. "How's it going? Did you find it?" "Who made such a big movement?" "I was shocked just now. I have to compete with that person if I have the chance." "You? Forget it, if you can catch half of that sword, you are lucky."... The God of Prophecy always closed his eyes, and his fingertips slowly traced lines of prophecy rules one after another in the void. After a moment, he opened his eyes with a solemn expression. "I got the prophecy." The gods gathered around him with a roar, and even the gods in the distance who were still arguing about the strength of the sword marks stopped talking and pricked up their ears. The God of Prophecy spoke, not loudly, but every word fell clearly into the ears of everyone present. "The person who destroyed Shikou City is the demigod who just arrived today." The whole place was silent for three breaths, and then exploded. "It just came? Isn't that a baby? It has this ability just after birth? What kind of monster does it have to grow up?" "It's so terrifying. Which descendant of a god has such ability?" The gods were talking about it, and no one noticed that the God of Prophecy lowered his eyes slightly. His slender fingers tapped the tortoise shell twice, very lightly, as if he had secretly hidden some answer that should not be spoken into the texture of the tortoise shell. At this moment, someone in the crowd suddenly spoke. "I remember... the God of Fury favored a woman in the mortal world a year ago." The discussion of the gods suddenly stopped, and everyone turned to look at the speaker. Being stared at by so many pairs of eyes, the man shrank his neck subconsciously, but he still had the courage to finish his sentence. "That woman lives in Shikou City." The scene suddenly became quiet. Everyone in the divine world knows that the angry god left a seed in the mortal world a year ago. At that time, he drunkenly boasted at the banquet that his son would definitely inherit his wrathful godhead in the future, which made the entire God Realm tremble. At that time, no one took it seriously. The angry god would say this every time he was drunk. There were more than a dozen illegitimate children recorded, but none of them were successful. But this time is different. In the direction of Shikou City, the aftermath of the sword's edge was still hissing in the void. That was not an attack that a newborn baby could unleash. But what if that baby inherits the wrathful Godhead of the Furious God, and accidentally triggers the inheritance of some more ancient laws when he is born? "Counting the days, it's almost the same." "I heard the God of Fury said before that he wanted to name the child Lei Jie. It couldn't be him." "Leijie... he destroyed a city when he was just born? What kind of monster did this Fury give birth to?" "Tsk, this is trouble. The God of Fury was originally a firecracker that exploded at a moment's notice, and now he has such a strong son. When the father and son join forces, will there be peace in the future? "How can you ever see peace with that angry temper? Now that your son is better than him, who will dare to mess with him?" "I don't even dare to mess with his son now. I must take it seriously."... At this time, a baby was just born in a hospital on the edge of Shikou City. This was Lei Jie who took the blame for Lin Mo, and was also the first generation demon king who would be feared in the future.
